title: workspace project remove
description: Stdout of `workspace project remove CODE --json`: a project that held no plans was removed from the workspace and from the bindings of this machine. Nothing is committed; the markers in the checkouts are not touched.

removed.description: Always true: a refusal prints the error document instead.

unbound.description: Absolute paths of the checkouts whose binding on this machine was dropped; empty when the project was not bound.

markers.description: Absolute paths of the checkouts that still hold the marker of the removed project (a subset of `unbound`).
